text:
Name: Belted Kingfisher - Megaceryle alcyon Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall.
Habitat: Near water; rivers, ponds, lakes and marshes. Nest in burrow of river bank or snad bank.
Foods: Fish is main diet but also crayfish, frogs and lizards.
Name: Woodpeckers - Family Picidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: May be found in or near any wooded area, in town, around buildings.
Foods: Various insects during summer months. All but hairy and downy migrate during winter and their diet consists of about 50% plant material including poison ivy, sumac, corn, pine.
Name: Tyrant Flycatchers - Family Tyrannidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall.
Habitat: Prefer mostly open country, farm yards, roadsides, scattered trees except traills, flycatcher, western flycatcher, western wood pewee, and olive-sided flycatcher.
Foods: Mostly insects captured during flight except for king birds and pheebes which consume a small portion of plant foods.
Name: Horned Lark - Eremophila alpestris
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall winter.
Habitat: Open areas such as plains, deserts, fields, airports, golf-courses. Nest in grass lined depression in ground.
Foods: Pigweed, goosefoot, ragweed, sedge, corn, wheat, sunflower, saltbush, chickweed, shepherds-purse, gromwell, Russian thistle and dropseed.
Name: Swallows - Family Hirundinidae
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall.
Habitat: Widespread; found in towns, near water, fields, canyons, wooded area etc. Barn and cliff swallow build mud nests, remainder use holes in bankes, trees, and crevices.
Foods: Insectivorous, capture food on the wing.
Name: Gray Jay - Perisoreus canadensis
Montana resident in: Spring, summer fall, winter.
Habitat: Coniferous forests. Nests are feather-lined bowls.
Foods: Omniverous.
Miscellaneous: Also called camp robbers.
Name: Black-billed Magpie - Pica pica
Montana resident in: Spring, summer, fall, winter.
Habitat: Free-ranging, maybe found in most areas of N. E. United States.

Prefers areas of moderate to dense cover.
Foods: Omniverous, will feed on berries, seeds, carrion, insects, etc. Miscellaneous: Good scavanger.
